channel.title: Sachin's notes
channel.description: Notes from Sachin, a civil engineer from coastal Karnataka who likes to code.

item.title: A dashboard for the parts of life I forget
item.description: I enjoy making little systems, maybe because engineering trains you to notice how many moving parts sit behind something that looks simple. Lately I've been curious about putting a few useful parts of my own life on one dashboard.

item.title: Learning to code with an engineer's eye
item.description: As a civil engineer, I'm used to thinking about what a thing has to do before worrying about how it looks. A drawing can be neat and still miss the point if the structure doesn't work. Coding has started to feel familiar in that way.

item.title: Why I'm starting this little blog
item.description: I keep collecting small thoughts in random places: a note on my phone, a file on my laptop, a message I send myself and never open again. Starting a blog is my attempt to give some of those thoughts one home.
